statutory_dues.text:
In respect of statutory dues:

The Company is regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues including provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income-tax, Goods and service tax, duty of customs, cess and other material statutory dues, as applicable, to the appropriate authorities. Further, no undisputed amounts payable in respect thereof were outstanding at the year-end for a period of more than six months from the date they become payable;

There are no dues in respect of income-tax, Goods and service tax, duty of customs that have not been deposited with the appropriate authorities on account of any dispute;

business_summary.text: Rossell Techsys Limited is a strategic Aerospace, Defense, Space & Semiconductor engineering and manufacturing platform.

call_points.text: Management expects sustained growth driven by new customer additions and capacity expansion
New facility in Aerospace Park, Bengaluru to enhance capacity for Aerospace, Defense, Space, Semiconductor, and Industrial programs
₹350 Cr of bids submitted during Q1FY27 with ₹240 Cr of new purchase orders received
Entered Defence MRO market through engagement with reputed Indian defence player
EBITDA margin band of 17-22% reiterated for current competencies, with improvement expected in FY27.
Bids of nearly ₹4,500 Cr submitted across aerospace, defence, space and semiconductor; more conversions expected.
Company leased about 2,10,000 sq ft near existing operations instead of building; space and semiconductor move there.
call_points.versus_prior: confirms the ₹30 Cr leased expansion announced in May

call_points.text: QIP planned at 7-10% of market cap for capacity, operational infrastructure and working capital.
call_points.versus_prior: new: first size range for the fundraise

call_points.text: Employee cost was about 15% of revenue in FY26, with improvement expected in FY27.
Boeing T-7 program has about USD 200 million of strategic agreements; ramp-up expected later this year.
Space business now with Amazon, not Blue Origin; semiconductor is wire harnesses only for now.
Analysts pressed on margin decline; management attributed it to qualification, training and automation investment, not mix.
Asked when cash flow turns positive, the CFO gave no date, only expecting improvement in coming years.
FY26 revenue of ~₹485 Cr exceeded original guidance; no FY27 revenue guidance is given.
The CFO says capital initiatives aim to reduce debt, strengthen the balance sheet and improve cash flows.
Semiconductor segment qualified and ramping volumes; space moved from qualification to scalable execution.
Commercial aerospace entry is being evaluated as a longer-term opportunity, not yet a commitment.

timeline.summary: Krishnappayya Desai, MD & CEO, reiterated Rossell Techsys’ 2-year growth strategy in *Deccan Herald* article dated April 27, 2026.
Harsh Mohan Gupta, promoter of Rossell Techsys Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter-held equity shares during FY2025-26 as per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Rossell Techsys received a repeat order for manufacturing electrical wire harnesses from an overseas defense customer.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹142.07 Cr (+61.6% YoY), net profit ₹7.52 Cr (+9.8% YoY).
Rossell Techsys announced a ₹30 Cr brownfield capacity expansion leasing 2,10,000 sq ft over the next 4-12 months.
Rossell Techsys' FY26 investor presentation reported revenue up 87% to ₹485 Cr, EBITDA ₹66.6 Cr and PBT ₹28.47 Cr, with a ₹715 Cr order book and over ₹3,000 Cr of strategic agreements.
Rossell Techsys reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹142.35 Cr (+62% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹485.2 Cr (+87%), recommending a ₹0.30 final dividend.
Rossell Techsys Limited shared Q4 FY26 earnings call recording on 12 May 2026 at 09:30 IST, covering performance, financials, and Q&A.
Rossell Techsys' 12 May 2026 earnings call guided FY27 revenue growth similar to FY26's 87%; a 17-22% margin band, 300-400% growth in semiconductor and space
Q1FY27: Revenue grows 78% YoY to ₹155 Cr, PBT surges 139% to ₹9.6 Cr; onboarded global semiconductor customer; secured new facility in Bengaluru; proposed QIP of ₹300 Cr.
Rossell Techsys Limited’s EGM on October 15, 2026, passed resolutions via remote e-voting and video conferencing with required majority under Scrutinizer Pramod S M (BMP & Co. LLP).
Rossell Techsys issued text clarifications on interim proceeds utilization and wilful defaulter undertakings for its preferential issue following stock exchange queries.
